patch.expectedSummary: Curious and energetic in her foster account, fourteen-month-old Polly offers an individual glimpse of the Puginese, a Pug–Pekingese cross. She enjoyed fetching small squeaky toys and exploring rooms for things to chew. She was shy with strangers and nervous on unfamiliar walks, becoming affectionate once settled; her foster also described rough, sometimes mouthy play.
